findings.evidence: Line 68 `abbrev ElementaryTwoQuotient (K) ... := TauCeti.ElementaryTwoQuotient (NarrowClassGroup K)`; lines 77–122 each have body `TauCeti.elementaryTwoQuotientMk_* ...`; `grep -rn "NarrowClassGroup.ElementaryTwoQuotient" TauCeti/` returns only a docstring mention in Exact.lean:32, so no consumer exists for any of them.
findings.fix: Drop the wrapper `def` (or make it an `abbrev`) and delete the restatements the file does not consume, keeping the genuinely new content: the induced map, `toClassGroup_eq_zero_iff`, and the four rank comparisons. Downstream then has one name per map and the general simp lemmas fire.
findings.issue: `elementaryTwoQuotientMk` is a fresh opaque `def` over `ElementaryTwoQuotient K`, which is an `abbrev` for `TauCeti.ElementaryTwoQuotient (NarrowClassGroup K)`; the general lemmas already apply to that type. The wrapper forces nine verbatim restatements (`_eq_zero_iff`, `_mul`, `_one`, `_inv`, `_div`, `_pow`, `_prod`, `_surjective`, `_eq_iff`, lines 77–122), none of which is used anywhere in the repo, and it blocks the general simp set — hence the `simpa only [toClassGroup, elementaryTwoQuotientMk]` at line 135 and the `hmap ... := rfl` bridge at lines 174–175. Same pattern for `ElementaryTwoQuotient.toClassGroup` (line 127) with its unused `toClassGroup_surjective` (line 139); the rank lemmas at lines 193/203/221 all use the group-level `NarrowClassGroup.toClassGroup_surjective` instead.

summary: The exactness results in Exact.lean sit at the right level with no unused or over-strong hypotheses, but the new elementary-abelian material in Basic.lean re-proves a special case of a general theorem already two screens above it, and the narrow-class-group file adds a ten-lemma specialization layer that restates the general API verbatim with no consumer.
